activity.notes: Telesilla is modeled as a fifth-century BCE Argive lyric poet. Oxford cautions that the later story of her arming Argive women may be fabricated, so ATLAS does not create a military command; c.500–c.450 is a broad representative artistic window reflecting conflicting ancient dating traditions.
